scope: Read-only analysis of archived target APK native touch ownership and published 1.8.11 helper/host fixture. Supports redesign; does not prove the device-specific cause of unchanged feel.

prior_helper.finding: All accepted ACTION_MOVE events return false and continue to the native handler. Only ACTION_UP sends native CANCEL. Per-sample rejection permanently discards active candidate; widening geometry alone does not change native ownership.

checks.finding: Builds the normalized native touch wrapper, resolves a key for each pointer, and calls ef0/d.l. This is the direct native route used by the helper for synthetic CANCEL.

ACTION_MOVE may call tj0/e.U for key tracking. ACTION_CANCEL iterates tracked pointers through tj0/e.E, calls D for the current pointer, then invokes pointerFinished ef0/n.f. Cancellation is more than a timer-only operation.

Keeps current key if oc0/l.g retains it or hit key is identical; otherwise switches pointer state. The slide branch calls the old key k (slide out) and new key h (slide in). Another configured branch calls old c and new d. Native MOVE is not an inert observation.
Native key retention compares distance from its own DOWN point against its configured radius and combines delegate results. This is separate from FlickSymbols acceptance thresholds.

On native DOWN, resets long-press flags and schedules a delayed Runnable using the timeout stored in field b. The timeout originates in hc0/k.a via the oc0/m constructor. Independent FlickSymbols qualification does not cancel this Runnable.
After slide-in, schedules a new delayed Runnable (or delegates to d under touch exploration). Leaving a native key does not mean the helper owns the remaining gesture.
Clears pressed/drag state; if native interceptor does not consume cancel, dispatches native cancel actions and calls b(token) on behavior delegates, including long press.
Clears long-press flags and removes the stored Runnable through n50/b.c, then nulls the Runnable reference.

The pointer-finished implementation inspects wb0/j1. OFF returns. Transient SYMBOL calls fb0/g0.g and sets OFF; transient SHIFT sets OFF and calls wb0/p1.f. A synthetic CANCEL can therefore alter layout/shift state; existing post-cancel actor/layout/editor validation must not be bypassed.
Sets the native touch matrix scale to 1/width and 1/height. No coordinate-normalization defect was established.

DOWN probabilistic key correction is gated by a prediction-type set initialized to NORMAL. JAPANESE bypasses that correction branch and falls back to geometric hit testing. Non-DOWN also uses geometric hit testing.

Native geometry applies edge-extension bits from e.c before RectF.contains. The helper uses the finite unextended rectangle, so edge eligibility differs, but this review does not establish that as the user-reported cause.

verified_native_cancel_chain: oc0/m.b -> delegate b when interceptor permits

published_hook_review.inspection: java com.sun.tools.javap.Main -c -p against actual published local MPP
published_hook_review.finding: No per-MOVE or onUpdateSelection reset hook was observed. The hook calls JapaneseGlide.handle before native d1.f. JapaneseGlide true branch clears only its active/pending state and returns true; it does not invoke FlickSymbols.reset.

prior_fixture_limit.finding: Records action numbers and counts CANCEL/UP with optional cancel callback. DOWN/MOVE do not arm a timer, change the current native key, run native delegates, or open a popup. Previous host assertion totals therefore do not validate competition with native long press or key sliding.

redesign_requirements: Once an eligible upward gesture qualifies, establish ownership before native CANCEL and consume remaining events until terminal UP/CANCEL or a fresh DOWN boundary.
Commit a character only on UP after retained editor/layout/key/actor/snapshot guards. Do not insert on MOVE.

A reset, settings change, exception, pointer mismatch or model change after native cancellation invalidates insertion while retaining drain ownership; never return a trailing UP to the canceled native stream.
Keep ownership and commit-validity separate, so lifecycle or reentrant CANCEL callbacks cannot erase the drain marker.
Keep native cancellation as one operation for the captured stream. Do not inject a new native DOWN or reconstruct a glide when the user later curves after capture.
Post-cancel layout/actor validation remains required because native pointer-finished callbacks can clear transient SHIFT/SYMBOL.
Expand host fixtures with explicit modeled native timer/key/popup effects and verify cancellation occurs before a qualifying MOVE reaches them; label these as fakes, not native execution.

conclusions.established: The previous recognizer and native keyboard both continue processing eligible upward MOVE events until UP. The actual native route has independent key transition and delayed long-press behavior. The prior host fixture omitted those effects.
conclusions.inference: Capturing on qualifying MOVE should stop native competition and make acceptance persist through ordinary trailing movement. This is a materially different design from changing thresholds.
conclusions.not_established: The current device build, exact user gesture samples, active refusal branch, and whether native competition caused this particular report. Physical feel and ART/native behavior remain untested.

baseline_host_reproduction.scope: Reran unmodified production 1.8.11 helper with existing explicit Android/native host fakes. Establishes detector behavior and sampling sensitivity; does not establish physical device cause or native-engine behavior.

findings: After a valid 40px upward MOVE, final upward 99px succeeds while 101px is rejected by UP_LIMIT.
Identical 35px right/35px up endpoints differ after an initial sideways23px accepted sample versus sideways25px rejected sample.
Identical45-degree50px/50px endpoints differ if an earlier25px right/10px up sample is present.

Up50 -> up30 -> up25 final endpoint succeeds when25px appears only as UP, but fails when25px also arrives as MOVE or history. Sampling/batching changes recognition because release tolerance is UP-only.

reviewed_invariants: Capture installs independent weak view/downTime drain marker and captured flag before invoking native CANCEL.
Reset invalidates insertion and increments generation while leaving the independent drain marker intact.
Cancellation exceptions and post-cancel state changes consume the current event and retain drain ownership until terminal.
Captured MOVE and history no longer apply distance, direction, reversal or elapsed-time veto; finite-coordinate and runtime-identity guards remain.
Actor insertion occurs only once on UP after retained connection/editor/model/layout/actor checks.
No synthetic replacement DOWN, duplicate native CANCEL, or replay into native/glide after capture.
Fresh DOWN clears stale stream state; pointer count/id, mismatched downTime, system CANCEL and model changes abort insertion and retain appropriate canceled-stream consumption.
Existing JapaneseGlide helper-true path clears Glide active/pending and returns true without resetting FlickSymbols.

activation_risk_review.finding: With 80px keys and 24px touch slop, a radial-only 19.2px minimum plus67.5-degree cone could permanently capture18px sideways/8px upward tap jitter.
activation_risk_review.correction: Capture additionally requires upward distance >= max(minimum*0.5, jitterSlop*0.5). This preserves the specific18/8px jitter sample as an undecided tap while retaining14/14px and40/17px diagonals.
activation_risk_review.limitation: The selected thresholds are an implementation tradeoff, not measured device error rates or proof that all accidental capture is eliminated.

independent_host_verification.scope: Compiled the final production Java source into an isolated classpath against existing explicit1811 Android/native fakes; no ART/device/native-engine execution.
independent_host_verification.baseline_contrasts_result: All nine RethinkGestureProbe cases now insert exactly one symbol with one native CANCEL, including101px straight path, initial sideways25px, shallow intermediate25/10px, and identical UP/MOVE/history endpoint variants.
ownership_cases: captured reset then drain and next fresh native tap
mismatched downTime then original UP drain

independent_host_verification.note: These supplemental assertions are separate from the release main-suite count and must not be represented as real native execution.
